projectDescription: N2AB Client is a browser/Electron-based mod client for the PolyTrack racing game that injects HUD overlays, performance tools, and visual enhancements directly into the game via a feature registry.
keyFeatures: Feature registry API (__api.registerFeature) for injecting custom modules
Performance overlay showing FPS, frame time, and 1% lows
Speed graph with rolling velocity trace
Checkpoint splits tracker with delta against best run
Input display (WASD/arrow key overlay) for recordings
Clean screen / cinematic mode that hides game HUD
Session stats (top speed, average speed, total distance)
Panel theme customizer with hue and surface darkness controls
Electron desktop app with auto-updater (N2AB updater)
Idempotent build tool that rebrands and patches the obfuscated bundle
Draco + WebAssembly physics engine (Bullet physics via Emscripten)
publicApiSurface: __api.registerFeature(name, descriptor) — registers a new module in the panel
descriptor.settings — declares range, bool, text setting fields
descriptor.onState(state) — called on every state change with active flag + setting values
descriptor.onToggle(active, state) — called specifically when the module is toggled
descriptor.category — one of: Movement | HUD | Network | Render
descriptor.mode — one of: toggle | hold | momentary
descriptor.transient — opt out of localStorage persistence
n2abOverlay(id, css) — create or retrieve a fixed overlay element
n2abRemove(id) — remove an overlay by id
n2abLoop(name, fn) — start a rAF loop keyed by name
n2abStop(name) — cancel a named rAF loop
n2abSpeed() — returns current car speed in m/s from __n2abSnap
window.n2ab(stateObj) — splash-screen update callback (states: local, info, downloading, verifying, restarting, uptodate, skipped, error)
electron IPC: quit, is-fullscreen, set-fullscreen, get-argv, log-message, fullscreen-change
node tools/build-n2ab-client.js — apply all transforms and write n2ab_client.bundle.js
node tools/build-n2ab-client.js --check — verify transforms without writing
obfuscated-string-codec.js encode/decode — custom base64-alphabet codec for the bundle string table
